Salesforce Admin Case Studies

Each case study documents the problem, what was configured, the skills it demonstrates, and real screenshots as proof of work.

✨ Agentforce Support Agent — Tier-1 Ticket Triage
Agentforce Builder · Developer Edition Org
✅ Complete
Problem Simulated
A support team needs first-line responses to common questions answered instantly, with anything complex or identity-sensitive handed to a human or gated behind verification — without losing conversation context.
What Was Built
  • Agent built in Agentforce Builder using the Service Agent template, with a Router and topic-specific subagents (General FAQ, Order Inquiries, Escalation, Case Management, etc.)
  • Service Customer Verification subagent gates sensitive requests (like order status) behind identity verification before proceeding
  • Escalation subagent calling the escalate_to_human action when a user explicitly requests a live agent, with a fallback to log a support case if escalation fails
What I'd Improve
Add guardrails for out-of-scope questions and test escalation accuracy across more edge cases.
Skills Demonstrated
Agentforce Builder, Topics & Subagents, Reasoning Instructions, Actions, identity-gated conversation design
Lead Routing Automation
Flow Builder · Record-Triggered Flow
✅ Complete
Problem Simulated
Inbound leads in a sample org needed to reach the right regional team automatically based on state, instead of relying on manual sorting — a common bottleneck in real sales teams.
What Was Built
  • Record-Triggered Flow firing on Lead creation
  • Decision element with West/East region outcomes based on State/Province
  • Update Records action per branch, tagging the Lead's Description with its assigned region team
What I'd Improve
Add round-robin owner reassignment per region instead of just tagging Description, and handle blank/unmapped state values.
Skills Demonstrated
Flow Builder, Record-Triggered Flows, Decision elements, Update Records, field-based conditional logic
Sales Performance Dashboard
Reports · Dashboards · Report Types
✅ Complete
Problem Simulated
Sales leadership needs a single view of pipeline health, win rate, and open deal value without digging through individual Opportunity records.
What Was Built
  • Opportunity report grouped by Owner and Close Date, with sum/win-rate/record-count summaries
  • Dashboard with 4 components: Sales Pipeline bar chart, Opportunities Won detail table, Total Open Opportunities KPI, and a Company Win Rate gauge
  • Mixed visualization types (bar, table, number, gauge) sourced from the same underlying report
What I'd Improve
Add a forecast-accuracy component comparing committed vs. closed, and schedule a weekly refresh/email delivery.
Skills Demonstrated
Report Builder, grouping & summaries, dashboard components (chart/table/metric/gauge), Reports & Dashboards for Lightning Experience (Trailhead badge earned)
Multi-Department Security Model
Profiles · Permission Sets · Role Hierarchy
🛠️ Design Scenario
Problem Simulated
Sales, Support, and Finance teams need access to shared records without seeing each other's sensitive fields.
What Was Built
  • Role hierarchy reflecting org reporting structure
  • Permission sets layered on baseline profiles per department
  • Field-level security on sensitive financial fields
What I'd Improve
Document a sharing-rule exception for cross-department deal collaboration.
Skills Demonstrated
Data Security, User Authentication, Identity Basics (Trailhead badges already earned)
Screenshots will be added once this case study is built.
Service Cloud Case Management
Case Object · Omni-Channel Routing · Escalation Rules
🛠️ Design Scenario
Problem Simulated
A support team needs incoming cases automatically routed to the right queue and escalated when they breach response-time targets — a core Service Cloud use case in current UAE/EU Salesforce Admin postings.
What Was Built
  • Case object configuration with custom fields, record types, and page layouts
  • Omni-Channel routing to assign cases to agent queues by workload
  • Escalation rules triggering reassignment when cases age past SLA
What I'd Improve
Layer in Agentforce for Service to auto-draft first responses on common case types.
Skills Demonstrated
Service Cloud configuration, Omni-Channel, case queues, SLA tracking, escalation rules
Screenshots will be added once this case study is built.

Practice Bank

Interview Preparation

Questions grouped by topic, generated from the real decisions made while building each case study above — not generic flashcards.

🤖 AI Agents (Agentforce)

How does your Agentforce agent decide when to verify identity before answering an order-status question?
What's the difference between a Topic and an Action inside Agentforce Builder?
Walk me through what happens when a user explicitly asks to speak to a human.

⚡ Automation (Flow)

When would you choose a Record-Triggered Flow over a Screen Flow?
How does your Lead Routing flow decide which region a new Lead is assigned to?
What's the difference between "Fast Field Updates" and "Actions and Related Records" when optimizing a Flow?

📊 Reports & Dashboards

What's the difference between a report and a dashboard component?
How would you build a dashboard showing both pipeline value and win rate on one page?
When would you use a gauge component instead of a bar chart?

🔐 Security & Access

How do you decide between Org-Wide Default of Private vs. Public Read Only?
What's the difference between a Role Hierarchy and a Sharing Rule, and when would you need both?
